code_gaps.root_cause: Real app (WKWebView) delete dialog: 取消 does not receive focus. The journey DOM readback delete_dialog_focus has activeElement = the session LI, in_dialog:false; the capture shows no ring on 取消 while the list item keeps its double outline. The harness (Chromium) delete-confirm shows the ring on 取消, so the dialog's focus() call works in Chromium. Cause not yet known: WKWebView may ignore focus() while the window is not key during the probe's eval. Carried over from round-2 N-01, now confirmed by DOM readback.
code_gaps.repair_suggestion: Reproduce with the app window key (activate it before opening the dialog). If focus still stays on the LI, move focus to 取消 after the dialog is shown (for example in requestAnimationFrame or after showModal) and add a WKWebView-side readback to the journey.

test_gaps.root_cause: Evidence framing. Library captures are scrolled past the tabs, and the image-page half of library-after-delete comes from verify-after-delete / real-after-delete. timeline-three-rounds is shown by the bottom/top pair. The real failed card's 详情 is collapsed; its content is visible in the harness attempt-failed capture.
test_gaps.repair_suggestion: Optional: in future runs also capture the library top with its tab bar, and an expanded 详情 in the real app.

visual_quality_gaps.root_cause: Expanded cards with no image (failed, cancelled, interrupted, file-missing) keep the prompt summary in the header and repeat the full prompt below, so the same prompt appears twice. Expanded done cards show it once. The round-2 repair report kept these cards unchanged on purpose (D-73, D-84), so this may be intended; it reads as duplication.
visual_quality_gaps.repair_suggestion: Hide the header summary on expanded non-image cards, or skip the full-prompt line when it equals the summary, so every expanded card shows the prompt once.

visual_quality_gaps.root_cause: Harness only: right after an image job is submitted (已用 0秒), the top bar still reads 媒体：空闲 · 可开下一件重活. In the real app, real-running-wide at 已用 3秒 correctly shows 图片生成中 / 媒体：生成中, and harness running-other-session-new-empty shows it too, so this is header polling lag at the capture instant, not wrong logic.
visual_quality_gaps.repair_suggestion: Optional: refresh the top-bar status as soon as an image job is accepted instead of waiting for the next poll.
